purpose: First real image-grounded region transcription fit of the unchanged TAC-OCR-001 TAC decoder; no architecture comparison or superiority claim
learning_rate_schedule: one-epoch linear warmup then cosine to 10% of peak
batch_order: NumPy default_rng SeedSequence([seed,epoch]); permute; length-sort pools of 1024; form batches of 64; shuffle batch list; retain last partial batch
selection: fixed epoch 15; no tuning, early stopping or DEV-selected weight promotion; retain every epoch
precision: FP32 encoder, pooling, cache and decoder; no AMP/quantization/compilation
working_memory: disk-backed read-only 128x384 FP32 features per unique crop; shared across seeds; minibatches only on GPU
state_policy: fresh decoder state per region; unique sample owner tokens are audit/control metadata outside learned tensors
prediction_boundary: image-derived features, fixed normalized spatial grid and previous generated bytes; evaluation starts from BOS; no gold text, target lengths, IDs, categories or future bytes enter prediction tensors
gpu_strategy: two disjoint image-only feature-cache shards followed by independent seed-1101 and seed-1102 TAC fits, one worker per physical GPU
required_gpu: exactly two physically observed NVIDIA T4 GPUs
privacy: private dataset and private notebook; credentials never included in either
training_readiness: BLOCKED pending independent original source/goal/scorer/actual ACL attestation and operator-pinned public verifier key
remaining_source_review: 12 cross-split perceptual near-image candidate pairs require manual adjudication
validation label conflicts remain original and require independent adjudication before a qualified accuracy claim
test_policy: no CORD TEST payload downloaded, mounted or evaluated; public/pretraining contamination remains unaudited
mathematics: unchanged TAC-OCR-001 exact-source graph and reciprocal PNDS PR105; shared operator/visual bridge verification partial; full-model forward/backward/precision proof OPEN
independent_evidence: canonical validate_research_parity preflight before any fit and final on actual checkpoint measurements before qualification; no agent-generated signing key or synthetic attestation
